tools.name: price2spy_get_products
tools.description: List the products tracked in Price2Spy with their brand, category, supplier, SKU, target price, cost price and lowest and highest competitor price. Filter by name, SKU, brand, category, supplier or price-change date. Uses POST /v1/get-products.

tools.name: price2spy_get_current_pricing_data
tools.description: Get the latest competitor prices: each matching product with every monitored URL, its shop name, last price, stock and the time of the check. Use this to compare your price with competitors. Uses POST /v1/get-current-pricing-data. Large accounts return a lot of data, so filter and keep limit low.

tools.name: price2spy_get_urls
tools.description: List monitored product page URLs with the shop name, country, last check time, last error, and the last two price measurements. Search by product id, SKU, internal id or name. Uses POST /v1/get-urls.

tools.name: price2spy_get_measurements
tools.description: Get the price history of one monitored URL: each measurement with price, currency, stock status, seller, shipping cost and promotion. Get the url_id from price2spy_get_urls. Uses POST /v1/get-measurements.

tools.name: price2spy_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands defined in this Price2Spy account, with ids. Use the names as filters in price2spy_get_products. Uses GET /v1/get-brands.

tools.name: price2spy_list_categories
tools.description: List the categories defined in this Price2Spy account, with ids. Use the names as filters in price2spy_get_products. Uses GET /v1/get-categories.

tools.name: price2spy_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers defined in this Price2Spy account, with ids. Use the names as filters in price2spy_get_products. Uses GET /v1/get-suppliers.

tools.name: price2spy_list_price_buckets
tools.description: List the price buckets (named price ranges) defined in this Price2Spy account, with ids. Price buckets are named price ranges (priceFrom, priceTo). Uses GET /v1/get-price-buckets.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: price2spy_get_products, price2spy_get_current_pricing_data, price2spy_get_urls, price2spy_get_measurements · Public sink: price2spy_get_products, price2spy_get_current_pricing_data, price2spy_get_urls, price2spy_get_measurements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: price2spy_get_products, price2spy_get_current_pricing_data, price2spy_get_urls, price2spy_get_measurements · Public sink: price2spy_get_products, price2spy_get_current_pricing_data, price2spy_get_urls, price2spy_get_measurements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
